props.name: enableGlobalShortcuts
props.description: Register top-level menu accelerators globally. Defaults to true.

props.name: enableMnemonics
props.description: Enable Alt+key mnemonics on Windows/Linux. Defaults to true on non-macOS.

props.name: enableTypeAhead
props.description: Enable type-ahead letter matching in open menus. Defaults to true.

props.name: revealed
props.description: iPadOS: bar hidden until revealed at the top edge.

props.name: showAppleMenu
props.description: macOS: show a read-only Apple menu stub (system-provided on real macOS).

props.name: standardOptions
props.description: Used when `menus` is omitted to build the standard HIG menu set.
